newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Achilles loading 25,000 tonnes sugar using big bags. Zara loading 22,800 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, five vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk.
Road: 300 trucks carrying sugar arrived between July 4 and 6. Loading: no figures available.

Vessels: Alan, Fratziz, Fulvia, Efrem, Tai Pan and Manley Exete each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Ar Raqib loading 14,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Tern loading 28,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Jurata loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, three vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk. At Cargill private terminal, no vessels docked or waiting to dock.
Stocks: 18,103 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
